purpose: Visual evidence for duplicate detection. Use these image files before deciding that source images are exact duplicates.
duplicateClassificationRule: Archive only images proven to be exact/same-slice/same-screenshot duplicates or unusable. Caption-only similarity is not enough; uncertain or merely similar images stay primary as recognition reinforcement.

entries.caption: Transvaginal longitudinal US shows an enlarged, 6-cm, edematous right ovary . Notice the echogenic, thickened follicle walls .

entries.caption: Transvaginal longitudinal color Doppler US shows no visible blood flow within the inferior half over the enlarged right ovary. Aphasic waveform is present with artifact that should not be confused for venous waveform . Notice the peripheralized follicles with echogenic, thickened walls . Trace-free fluid is present in the right adnexal region .
